audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was given to Camille although this page's own whys[4] and spikes[1] describe Ornn's ultimate answering hers, and the first-item row was called even although whys[5] describes her diving Ornn on that spike. Both rows disagreed with the packet chart.
audit.why: Call of the Forge God charges and can be recast for a second ram, which is Ornn's answer to being anchored by The Hextech Ultimatum. Her Sheen-line first item, by contrast, lets her dive Bellows Breath's downtime.
audit.corrected: Row 5 (Level 6) to Skill and row 6 (first item) to Camille, in matched full/content pairs, giving the packet chart; ratings moved with them.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why and phases[5].why were boilerplate; neither named a spike.
audit.why: Level 6 is Call of the Forge God (140s at rank 1) against The Hextech Ultimatum (140s). The first-item spike belongs to her.
audit.corrected: Both whys rewritten to name the actual spike and who owns it.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.you[1] told the player to use the magma pillar to deny Hookshot grip points. That is backwards — Hookshot pulls to a wall, and the pillar is terrain, so it hands her an anchor. Adaptive Defenses, Tactical Sweep's heal and Precision Protocol's empowered auto were all absent.
audit.why: Hookshot needs terrain; Volcanic Rupture creates terrain. Adaptive Defenses shields specifically against the damage type that hit her, so armour alone is not the answer and Precision Protocol's true damage ignores it anyway. Tactical Sweep heals off its outer cone, which is what Grievous Wounds is for.
audit.corrected: wants.you[1] inverted to a warning; breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dosFull[1].d and all three dontsFull bodies now carry the real names, the 16s Hookshot, the 9s Precision Protocol tell and the W heal.

notes: The worst error here was wants.you[1], which told the player their magma pillar denies Hookshot grip points; it does the opposite, because Hookshot pulls to terrain and the pillar is terrain. Not asserted: the kit file flags The Hextech Ultimatum as 'untargetable' and the _missing file asks for untargetable-dodges-burst advice, but Riot's description says only that she dashes to a target champion and anchors them — no untargetability. Per the trust-the-description rule nothing was written about waiting out an untargetable window.
